tasks.title: Fill in the 7 questions, ballpark is fine
Copy answers and paste them into the chat
Write down each account's balance and type
Grab the latest mortgage statement
Export 3 months of transactions as CSV
Build the bucket snapshot and categorize spending
Build the month-by-month runway model with 4 scenarios
Draft a withdrawal order, cheapest bucket first
Review whether the scenarios match how life feels
Pick your green / yellow / red thresholds
Write 'if yellow, do X' playbooks for each number
Optional: session with a fee-only planner or CPA on withdrawal order
Publish the dashboard page with the 4 numbers
Add a link to the dashboard from your life dashboard
Do the first monthly update together
Rate each income track on pay rate, speed, reliability, enjoyment, long-term value
Set up weekly review that sends 3-5 tasks to Todoist
Put a recurring 20-minute review on your calendar
Optional: connect a budgeting app's CSV export for auto updates
Optional: add alerts when a number changes zone
